principles: Keep review_run_start ordering mechanically obvious: refusal checks that guard snapshot creation must run before snapshot capture.
Preserve existing policy semantics: only move the preflight boundary, do not change dirty classification, material hash computation, or review evidence freshness rules.
Use black-box smoke coverage for the ordering regression so future refactors cannot silently move the gate behind snapshot capture again.
drivers: Dirty material-source changes must be rejected before a review run snapshot can be captured.
Unreadable git-status fail-open behavior should remain meaningful because snapshot capture should not happen first.
The fix touches REVIEW gate evidence production, so the verification must be deterministic and narrow.

options.name: A: Move the existing preflight block before captureReviewRunSnapshot and add an ordering smoke
pros: Minimal behavior change that directly matches the bug.
Keeps existing dirty-worktree policy and hash semantics intact.
The smoke catches the exact ordering regression.
cons: Requires updating existing diagnostics expectations where snapshot failures used to happen first.

options.name: B: Leave handler order unchanged and only adjust diagnostics
cons: Does not fix the actual gate ordering bug.
Fail-open preflight remains bypassed by earlier snapshot failure paths.

options.name: C: Refactor snapshot capture and preflight into a shared orchestration helper
pros: Could make ordering explicit in a reusable abstraction.
cons: Larger blast radius for a narrow bug.
Risks changing unrelated review-run behavior while trying to fix one ordering issue.

chosen: A: Move the existing preflight block before captureReviewRunSnapshot and add an ordering smoke
rationale: Choose the narrow relocation plus targeted smoke because it directly fixes the REVIEW evidence gate ordering while preserving the existing dirty-worktree and freshness semantics.

preMortem.scenario: Preflight is moved before snapshot but accidentally changes classification behavior.
preMortem.trigger: The relocation rewrites classifierOptionsForCheck or isBlockingDirty inputs instead of moving the existing block intact.
preMortem.consequence: review_run_start starts rejecting or allowing different dirty trees than before.
preMortem.mitigation: Keep the same readGitStatusLines/classifyGitStatusRows/isBlockingDirty calls and run the existing clean-tree preflight smoke.

preMortem.scenario: The new smoke only checks the final error text and misses ordering.
preMortem.trigger: A dirty tree still errors after snapshot capture, so a weak assertion passes even if the bug returns.
preMortem.consequence: The regression can reappear without test failure.
preMortem.mitigation: Assert no review run is persisted and use a scenario where the preflight error must win before snapshot-derived behavior.

preMortem.scenario: Moving the preflight too early loses required workspace context.
preMortem.trigger: The block is placed before signedWorkspaceRoot or metadata root resolution is available.
preMortem.consequence: review_run_start throws unrelated errors or uses the wrong config root.
preMortem.mitigation: Place the block immediately after the REVIEW phase check, where workspace, signedWorkspaceRoot, store, and ctx.root are already in scope.
